build_builtin_table: build a lazy-initialized mapping of Python builtins to ATen operator names using _get_builtin_table
create_register_builtin: create a builtin registration by calling _register_builtin with a function and its ATen op name string
find_builtin_op: find the ATen operator name for a Python function using _find_builtin
test_builtin_ops_list: test the _builtin_ops list containing pairs of Python functions and their corresponding ATen op names
review_special_functional_ops: review _is_special_functional_bound_op which checks if a function belongs to special functional-bound operations
